core_meaning.short_meaning: The ever-accepting of repentance; a divine name in the Qur'an
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Tawwab (التواب) is a divine name meaning “the One who repeatedly accepts repentance”. It occurs in the Qur'an in verses including 2:37, 2:54, 2:128, 2:160, 9:104, 9:118, 49:12 and 110:3. The related noun tawbah means repentance, and Tawwab is used as a male given name.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: The root ت و ب carries the sense of returning and repenting. The intensive form تواب is used for God as the frequent acceptor of repentance. As a personal name it is an attribute-name; the record does not claim the bearer possesses the divine attribute.
